description: Create one deal in Attio without choosing resource_type. Never update existing deals or create companies, people, or tasks. May require explicit user approval from the host. Requires record_data with deal attribute API slugs such as name, stage, value, owner, or associated company/person references. If stage or owner values are rejected, call discover_record_attributes or get_record_attribute_options for deals.

record_data.description: Deal fields to create. Use Attio attribute API slugs as keys.

name: create_deal
